name: navbar-vertical-spacing
goal: Give the explorer navbar and wrapped branch/commit row vertical breathing room while retaining compact selectors and the divider

evidence: Navigation touches its outer edges, and wrapped revision controls have only 2px above/below. Require 8px breathing room while retaining the divider and 32px fields.
Existing standardized shell tests check compactness and divider geometry but no minimum vertical inset. Extend that same desktop/tablet/mobile scenario with measured spacing assertions.
137de60c: isolated test fails with space above navigation (0px, expected >=8) across desktop, tablet and mobile. Immutable red checkpoint recorded before CSS repair.
8460b62c adds 8px block padding to the shared header and wrapped revision row, retaining compact fields and the divider.
8460b62c: all 9 unchanged navigation tests pass in an isolated clean snapshot; same command, environment, tests and fixtures as red.
